jobs.title: Part-time Clerk/Company Secretary (remote working - apart from 4 meetings p.a.) - 3741
jobs.description:
Job Description

Our client is a charitable limited company with 7 Trustees, based in North Yorkshire. It holds a substantial amount of land and property for the benefit of the community.


The trustees are now looking for a Clerk/Company Secretary to the Trustees. This is a replacement role as the current incumbent is relocating out of the area. The role will be offered on a part-time basis of c.10 hours a week, so it would suit a candidate who is part or fully CGI qualified looking to add an extra client to a portfolio role perhaps. This role can largely be done remotely/ from home, as there is no formal office to be based at, however the quarterly Directors meetings are held face to face, so the ability to get to meetings in the Skipton area will be a practical consideration (meetings usually held Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct).


A full job description is available on request.


Duties will include;

  • Preparation of agenda for meetings and attendance at such meetings, preparing minutes on a timely basis for approval by the Chairman and circulation to the Board.
  • Implementation of decisions made by the Trustees at meetings where such decisions, which may relate to the formal business of the charity, are not delegated to the charity’s Managing Agents.
  • Provision of advice to the Trustees at Board meetings and, as necessary, in communications issued to consult and update the Trustees on a day-to-day basis in respect of the charity’s business, and in particular in the preparation of information and briefings required for effective decision-making by the Board.
  • Administration of the charity and the charitable company, liaising with and monitoring the implementation of decisions delegated to the Trust’s Managing Agents for land and property holdings.
  • Administration and management of payments systems, including issuing approved grant payments, from the Trust’s bank accounts, using the approved procedures with required dual signatory approvals.
  • In consultation with the Trust’s accountants, preparation of the Annual Return for the charity and of the statutory accounts for the company.
  • Carrying out administration for the successful running of the Trust as a charity and as a charitable limited company, including filing of documents and maintenance of the statutory records.
  • Administration of the charity’s website [and social media outlets], updating published information and posting items as appropriate, and preparing press releases as necessary in consultation with the Chairman of the Trustees.

jobs.title: Finance Business Partner (part time)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Are you a commercially minded finance professional who enjoys partnering with stakeholders, influencing decision-making, and improving financial understanding across a business?

We are recruiting for a part-time FBP to join a complex and evolving organisation undergoing significant change within its finance function. This is an opportunity to move beyond transactional finance and play a key role in supporting operational teams, improving financial visibility, and driving better commercial decision-making.

The role

You will:

  • Partner closely with budget holders and operational teams across the organisation
  • Provide financial insight, forecasting, and variance analysis to support decision-making
  • Improve financial understanding and accountability among non-finance stakeholders
  • Support budgeting and monthly management reporting processes
  • Analyse financial data and produce meaningful reporting using Excel
  • Help improve existing processes, reporting, and controls within a manual finance environment
  • Contribute to wider commercial initiatives and future finance improvements
About you
  • Experience within Finance Business Partnering, Management Accounting, or a commercially focused finance role
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Confident challenging and supporting non-finance teams
  • Strong Excel skills including Pivot Tables and VLOOKUPs
  • Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable working within evolving environments

Qualifications and sector experience are not essential — strong practical experience and the ability to build relationships are more important.

Location & hours
  • Part-time opportunity (2–4 days per week)
  • Hybrid working available, with some on-site presence preferred
  • Flexibility around working pattern

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - Self-Employed Conractor (Remote, full or part time)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Sales Development Representative — Self-Employed Contractor (Remote or Hybrid, Full or Part Time)


At FISCAL Technologies, we're not just selling software — we're partnering with finance leaders to protect over £350 billion of global spend every year through innovative AI-driven solutions that deliver ROI within three months.


We're looking for a passionate relationship builder who can open doors, book meetings and help develop sales opportunities — and who wants the flexibility and independence of working as a self-employed contractor rather than as a PAYE employee.


Important — please read before applying


This is a self-employed consultancy engagement, not an employed role. You'll invoice us on an agreed day rate, be responsible for your own tax and National Insurance (or local equivalent), and carry your own professional indemnity insurance. If you're looking for a salary, holiday pay, pension contributions or other employee benefits, this engagement isn't the right fit.


We have a strong preference for candidates based in the UK, US or Canada. For data security and information governance reasons, applications from candidates based and authorised to work in one of these three countries will be prioritised.


Successful candidates will be required to complete a basic background/security check, carried out in their country of residence, before being granted access to our internal systems. This is in line with our information security and data protection commitments to our customers.


The role


Working directly with our new business sales and marketing teams, your focus will be booking qualified new business meetings:


• Prospecting and lead generation — identifying and researching organisations that fit our ideal customer profile

• Outbound outreach — initiating contact through phone, email and social channels

• Lead qualification — assessing interest, budget and need against agreed criteria

• Booking meetings — scheduling qualified meetings and demonstrations for Account Executives

• Reporting and tracking outcomes

• Collaboration — working closely with sales and marketing colleagues on strategy and messaging


Required skills and experience


• Excellent verbal, written and listening communication

• Strong organisation and time management — comfortable managing a high volume of activity

• Proficiency with CRM systems and modern sales tools

• Persistence, self-motivation and the discipline that goes with self-employed working

• Prior SDR, BDR or outbound prospecting experience preferred


Commercial terms

• Day rate and weekly commitment to be agreed — we have flexibility on both

• Monthly invoicing, paid within 14 days of approved invoice

• Initial probation period with a short notice period, continuing by agreement thereafter

• Remote or hybrid (occasional visits to the office in Reading are possible with time and travel costs reimbursed)


Why FISCAL?


• Be part of an exciting growth company protecting organisations around the world

• Our solutions deliver meaningful impact for finance teams worldwide

• Flexibility and independence as a self-employed partner, not an employee

• Work alongside experienced sales and marketing colleagues backed by strong product-market fit


FISCAL Technologies is a previous recipient of the Queen's Award for Enterprise (Innovation) and is recognised as a great place to work. We're committed to working with a diverse network of contractors and partners that reflects the clients we serve.


To apply, please send a short message outlining your relevant experience, your location, and your indicative day rate and weekly availability.
